title: Field Operations Note: Equipment Release, Booked Start and Site Conditions
content:
# Field Operations Note — Equipment Release, Booked Start and Site Conditions

The rule under which Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects are booked into the schedule and run on site.

## Release of the equipment order

Equipment is released to the supplier once the deposit is received and, where the class requires one, the owner-named insurance certificate has been issued. Receipt of the deposit is read from the project's own record entries — the deposit billing and the payment applied against its invoice — and not from the owner's statement that it has been sent.

## The booked start

The booked start is set from the quoted lead time for the principal equipment type, counted in whole weeks from the day the equipment order was released. A lead time the supplier later extends moves the booked start without changing the contract value.

## Storage of early deliveries

> Equipment delivered before the site can receive it is stored, and storage beyond the week of delivery carries the tier's weekly storage charge, counted per whole week begun.

The clause above is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current basis; the class's weekly storage charge remains a value of the class.

## Mobilisation, temporary cooling and after-hours work

Mobilisation starts the schedule guarantee where the class carries one.

Temporary cooling during the changeover is provided at no charge only where the class includes it; elsewhere it is charged at the class's daily rate for each day it stands on site.

After-hours and weekend installation is performed at no premium only where the class includes it; at other classes the premium is added to the labor of those hours, and to those hours only.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- An order released on a Monday for a unit quoted at 8 weeks is booked to start 8 whole weeks later; when the supplier later quotes 10 weeks, the booked start moves 2 weeks and the contract value does not change.
- A deposit the owner reports as posted, with no payment yet applied against the deposit invoice on the project's record entries, does not release the equipment order.
- In a class that does not include temporary cooling, a portable unit standing on site from the 3rd to the 5th inclusive is charged for 3 days at the class's daily rate.
